climate.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0), based on Copernicus ERA5 reanalysis. Model estimates, not station observations or forecasts.
climate.rainDefinition: Fraction of historical days with at least 1 mm total precipitation; not a forecast rain probability.
climate.humidityDefinition: Daily mean outdoor relative humidity; comfort preference only, not a health assessment.

method.crowdBands: First six ranked months BEST; next three AVERAGE; last three WORST. Rankings are editorial proxies, not observed percent-of-capacity figures.
method.priceBands: Same six/three/three ordinal bands, based on accommodation-demand guidance; no live prices.
method.festivalScore: Listed flagship event or two regional events: 100; one regional event: 50; no listed event: 0. Prominence is editorial.
method.overall: Weighted score >=65 BEST; >=40 AVERAGE; otherwise WORST. Absolute thresholds; no forced BEST/WORST quotas.
method.calendar: Typical recurring months, not guaranteed event schedules. Carnival and Santo Cristo follow Easter; Easter demand shifts are approximations. Confirm event dates before travel.
method.limitations: Crowd and price inputs are provisional editorial proxies and must be replaced by measured monthly data when available. Full-month averages hide short holiday spikes; climate grid cells can miss coastal and mountain microclimates.

crowds.basis: provisional editorial ordering of months, not measured visitor percentiles

prices.basis: provisional accommodation-demand proxy; no measured hotel-price index or airfare data

profiles.eventCoverage: Selected sourced events only; zero means no listed event, not proof that no events occur.
